# code-writer

Delegate boilerplate code generation to AiKA. Use for tests, config, docstrings, type stubs, or any generation where >80% is predictable from reference files.

Ships in the [`shunt`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install shunt@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add shunt@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install shunt@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
